task_description: Fix iOS sandbox permissions so CD-based PS1 games (native multi-file .cue/.bin) load in Continuum, on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed. Root cause: a single-file .fileImporter grants a security scope to only the picked .cue, so the C++ core's fopen of the adjacent .bin is denied. Implement BOTH complementary options: (1) PRIMARY - switch the picker to a FOLDER importer (allowedContentTypes: [.folder]), hold folder-level security scope for the session, enumerate the folder to select the launch entry by extension priority (.cue > .pbp > .iso > .chd > .bin), and pass that entry's absolute path to engine.launch (need_fullpath, Rust unchanged); (2) SECONDARY - enable UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace, injected via project.yml info.properties because XcodeGen overwrites the generated Info.plist. Update SESSION_HANDOFF.md section 17. No .chd conversion. No Rust/build-script/ios.yml changes. Commit locally only; do not push or open a PR (orchestrator handles CI and the .ipa).

verification.semantic_review: v1 APPROVED (.agents/tasks/task-ios-multifile-cuebin/2026-09-18-015421-review.md). No blocking concerns. Neither was actioned; both are cosmetic and out of the fix's critical path.
